description: This file contains functions and constants for resolving and analyzing shell command wrappers, including detection of shell types, inline commands, and nested dispatch wrappers within command argument arrays.

methods.name: isWithinDispatchClassificationDepth
methods.description: Checks if the current depth is within the maximum allowed dispatch wrapper depth.

methods.name: isShellWrapperExecutable
methods.description: Determines if a given token corresponds to a recognized shell wrapper executable.

methods.name: unwrapKnownShellMultiplexerInvocation
methods.description: Attempts to unwrap a command array if it is invoked via a known shell multiplexer wrapper, returning the wrapper type and unwrapped arguments.

methods.name: hasEnvManipulationBeforeShellWrapper
methods.description: Checks if environment manipulation occurs before a shell wrapper in a command argument array.

methods.name: extractShellWrapperInlineCommand
methods.description: Extracts inline commands from a shell wrapper command argument array.

methods.name: extractShellWrapperCommand
methods.description: Extracts the shell wrapper command and determines if the argument array is a wrapper.
